confirmedFindings.title: Catastrophic regular expression backtracking (ReDoS) in route authorization filter
confirmedFindings.body: Nested quantifiers in API_ROUTE_PATTERN cause exponential backtracking on long non-matching paths, freezing the event loop.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Simplify regex to a linear pattern without nested grouping or parse path segments with URL or String.split("/").
